metadata.name: Privacy Shield
metadata.description: Shuts down diagnostics pipelines, telemetry services, and data collection scheduled tasks while keeping core OS features intact.

tweaks.name: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
tweaks.defaultBehavior: Collects telemetry and experience data for Microsoft analytic services, continuously uploading diagnostics in the background.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Stops telemetry upload and prevents the DiagTrack service from restarting automatically.
tweaks.notes: Windows 10/11 Home users may see diagnostics options greyed out while the service is disabled.

tweaks.name: Device Management Wireless Application Protocol
tweaks.defaultBehavior: Coordinates push notifications and telemetry payload delivery for Microsoft services.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Prevents Microsoft push telemetry from transmitting in the background. Standard notifications continue through Windows Push Notification Service.
tweaks.notes: Rarely used outside of enterprise device management.

tweaks.name: CEIP Consolidator Scheduled Task
tweaks.defaultBehavior: Collects and uploads customer experience data daily as part of the Customer Experience Improvement Program.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Prevents CEIP data collection and upload tasks from running automatically.
tweaks.notes: Windows may recreate these tasks after feature updates; the undo log captures the original state for restoration.

tweaks.name: Telemetry Consent Level
tweaks.defaultBehavior: Gives Microsoft permission to collect optional diagnostic data unless policies say otherwise.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Pins telemetry to the minimal 'Security' level supported by the SKU.
tweaks.notes: SKU limits apply: Windows 10/11 Home and Pro treat 0 as 'Required' only; Enterprise/Education honor true Security-only telemetry.

tweaks.name: Enforce Policy Changes Immediately
tweaks.defaultBehavior: Registry changes written to HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\... are only picked up by running processes on the next Group Policy background refresh cycle, which happens roughly every 90 minutes.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Triggers an immediate non-blocking Group Policy refresh (gpupdate /force) so the telemetry and privacy policy changes take effect right now, not in an hour and a half.
tweaks.notes: gpupdate is run with /wait:0 so it's non-blocking. The /target:computer flag limits the refresh to machine policies only, which is all we modified.

tweaks.name: Boot Persistence
tweaks.defaultBehavior: Windows Update and the CBS (Component Based Servicing) stack can silently reset service startup types and re-enable scheduled tasks after feature updates or even monthly patches.
tweaks.whenDisabled: Registers a startup scheduled task under \WGE\ that re-runs this preset at every boot as SYSTEM. Think of it as a bouncer who clocks in every morning and quietly puts things back the way you like them - even after Windows tries to undo everything overnight.
tweaks.notes: The task runs under SYSTEM with Highest privilege level. You can inspect it in Task Scheduler under the \WGE\ folder. If you move the dist folder after applying, update the task's action path to match the new location.
